content:
If you love the new wallpaper Apple designed for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use it—you can download it right here right now.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpaper

Although iOS default wallpapers are dynamic, responding to the device's movement and gestures, the following are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 release candidate.

The release candidate doesn't appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to click the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're using an iOS device).
